item.title: Mobilink Bank achieves ISO 27001 certification for its robust Information Security System
item.description: Pakistan’s leading digital microfinance bank, Mobilink Bank, has achieved ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, which is a globally recognized standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) awarded to organizations that meet international standards for data security. The achievement demonstrates the strength of Mobilink Bank’s information security governance, its systematic approach to managing cyber risks, and protecting customer [...]
